title: Closeouts
lead: Who closes out, how (run, speed, timing, angle), what the ball handler does next, and how that depends on his shooting and driving.

blocks.text: A closeout is a defender running at a player who has just caught the ball. It is a trade.

items: Close tight and fast, and he may drive past you
Stay back, and he may shoot
This tab describes SkillCorner's closeouts in the ten games, the defender's run from the tracking, what the ball handler did next, and how that depends on what kind of player he is

sections.title: What this shows and does not

items: It shows how closeouts are run in these games and what follows them, split by the defender's run and by the kind of player closed out on
It does not grade defenders. Most have under ten closeouts, and the player they close out on drives the outcome
SkillCorner's closeout detection itself is not validated here
Closeout value = the outcome after the closeout minus what that ball handler usually produces from the same spot (season and tracked priors)
Pool it per defender with shrinkage
Then separate the run (speed, angle, timing) from the result
